latest_release.body:
## Changelog
### Features
* 86c01c8f929e42cd1ced665143bd35b73e38ae8e feat: add an SSH gateway for native clients and SFTP file transfer in the web terminal
* 45af014d323b83857b7cb08bcb716baf92efa935 feat: connect Telnet assets natively and remove guacd and the unused Remote App settings
* 3c1ba05379b5abd75ce08c0a5337a15670976baf feat: draw web RDP through the graphics pipeline like the Windows client
* ac16d6435adee8ddd8d543b4a5eb2956ddbd1eab feat: draw web RDP updates a frame at a time, at the screen's pixel density and with the remote cursor
* ffcc0301b2d158e69bca9ac9ffbfa323eb259139 feat: generate i18n strings from the tsx frontend without dropping existing translations
* 5bf61321e0585d860c19240a7741959015eaec8e feat: keep installing updates on the asset and follow the install again after Casvisor restarts
* 1af49b6a5adbfc36d72211a3fcaba072262d6792 feat: let network gateway agents connect over HTTPS through the web address
* 0dc4d01a25e6192e32fa1f2077cbd3534077a5bf feat: reach assets in other networks through SSH jump host network gateways
* 28ebd1b91ca892138839be9be78db71b0c807a75 feat: reach networks behind NAT through network gateway agents that connect out to Casvisor
* 39f694b0978172ad63b83cb4ed5ee150a173c5e7 feat: record SSH, Telnet, VNC and RDP sessions and replay them in the browser
* 6a12c00682c7f0b3f1708439716a7b4a43d5fe82 feat: record and block SSH commands, monitor sessions live and disconnect revoked sessions
* cf08d513f35a9531482643bb949646ad7fd2ac39 feat: remove the old web frontend
* ccba35f85f491fbffc6adda2e3ed26697a3e77fe feat: run out of the box with SQLite and built-in user accounts when no Casdoor is configured
* a1c2edeebb3ad7b91c79bcdc2baf36aaaf13bcb3 feat: scan, install and restart for system updates of SSH assets
* 8b1dcfeb450b2da0105f3fcca051ed472c4ae52c feat: sync the clipboard and follow the window size in web RDP sessions
* f8b1c5c9a3be649ebf79b7d64e7d54a5d53288cf feat: transfer files in web RDP sessions through a redirected gateway drive
### Bug fixes
* d2ff43006cd7b128a94b44bce155ffd90deb51c3 fix: connect RDP to FreeRDP-based hosts such as Ubuntu with NLA
* 9f8a20b9ceeab6bc4e47e80b13f08a3872781330 fix: connect RDP to Windows 11 hosts that refuse CredSSP over TLS 1.3
* e1ad8a1fc3d44589fd8fe5cae4af5867522f2b20 fix: draw ClearCodec glyphs in rows of the width they are drawn at
* 1081b331f65bc778b85d1a4bcfe11c4062a5f12a fix: ignore the local database and recordings directories
* f55d1c28fc07e98b08ada02c0a9c23063041f90e fix: match the SSH protocol of assets case-insensitively in patch management
* 863fbe492cf289d6003e71831cec446cb03632d4 fix: run the Windows update scripts from a file in the SSH PowerShell instead of powershell -EncodedCommand

detail.readme:
📦⚡️ Casvisor

An open-source bastion host (jump server) for SSH, RDP, VNC and Telnet, written in Go and React.

Online demo | Documentation | Issues | LINUX DO

Casvisor sits between the people who run your servers and the servers themselves. People open SSH, RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions from a browser tab, or use their own `ssh`, `scp` and VS Code through Casvisor's SSH gateway. They only reach the servers a permission gives them, never see the servers' passwords, and every session is recorded. - **One Go binary.** All four protocols are handled inside Casvisor, with nothing to install on the servers. It runs on SQLite with its own accounts out of the box. - **Apache-2.0, no enterprise edition.** Recording, the SSH gateway, network gateways and everything else in this README are in the open-source project. - **Policy you can read.** Permissions are enforced with [Casbin](https://casbin.apache.org), and sign-in can be handed to [Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai) for SSO, MFA, LDAP and social logins. ## Features **Connect** - **SSH** in an xterm.js terminal, with a file panel beside it for upload and download over SFTP. - **RDP** with [gordp](https://github.com/casvisor/gordp), a pure-Go RDP client: NLA, the GFX graphics pipeline (ClearCodec, RemoteFX Progressive) like the Windows client, sharp text on high-DPI screens, the remote cursor, clipboard, resizing with the window, and file transfer through a redirected drive. Works with Windows Server, Windows 10/11 and FreeRDP-based hosts such as Ubuntu. - **VNC** with noVNC. Casvisor does the VNC authentication itself, so the password stays on the server. - **Telnet** for network gear and old systems, logging in with the asset's account. - **SSH gateway** on port 2222: `ssh -p 2222 web-01@casvisor.example.com`, `scp`, `sftp`, `rsync`, Xshell and VS Code Remote, signed in with the user's public key and under the same permissions as the browser. - **Port forwarding to any asset** for clients of its own protocol: `ssh -p 2222 -N -L 13389:win-01:3389 alice@casvisor.example.com`, then mstsc, a VNC viewer or a database client connects to `localhost:13389`. Needs the `Forward` action; the bytes pass through as they are, so the user logs in to the asset with its account, and the connection is listed as a session and logged but not recorded. - **Network gateways** for assets Casvisor cannot reach directly: through an SSH jump host, or through an agent that connects out from a private network over HTTPS. - **Stored credentials.** Passwords and private keys are encrypted in the database and filled in by Casvisor. SSH host keys and RDP certificates are pinned on first use. **Control** - **Permissions** on users, groups, assets and asset tags, with the actions `Connect`, `Copy`, `Paste`, `Upload`, `Download` and `Forward`, client IP ranges and a time window. - **Command rules** that block or flag commands matching a regular expression, in the web terminal and through the SSH gateway alike. - **Revocation takes effect at once.** Open sessions are disconnected as soon as their permission is edited, deleted or expires. **Audit** - **Session recording and playback** for SSH, Telnet, VNC and RDP, replayed in the browser with the same code that drew them live. SSH and Telnet recordings can be downloaded as asciicast. - **Live monitoring** of online sessions, and stopping any of them. - **Command records** of SSH and Telnet sessions, read off a virtual screen, so tab completion, history and line edits are captured as they ran. - **Operation log** of file transfers and every change made through the API. **Operate** - **Patch management** for SSH assets: scan for pending system updates, install them and restart, on Windows (Windows Update) and on Linux (apt, dnf, yum). - **Web console** in 9 languages, built with React, Vite and shadcn/ui, with a RESTful API and [Swagger docs](swagger). ## Quick start ```shell docker run -d --name casvisor -p 19000:19000 -p 2222:2222 \n -v casvisor-db:/db -v casvisor-recordings:/recordings casbin/casvisor docker logs casvisor ``` Open http://localhost:19000 and sign in as `admin` with the password printed in the log, then change it in **My Account**. Pass `-e adminPassword=` to choose the first password instead. Then add a server under **Assets** and click **Connect**. Administrators reach every asset; to let other people in, add them under **Users** and give them a **Permission**. The repository's [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml) does the same with Docker Compose. Port 2222 is the SSH gateway. Users add their public key under **SSH keys** and connect with `ssh -p 2222 @`. To use mstsc, a VNC viewer or another client of the asset's own protocol, forward a local port with `ssh -p 2222 -N -L :: @`; the asset list copies this command for each RDP, VNC and Telnet asset. ## Installation from source Requires Go 1.23 and Node.js 20 with Yarn. ```shell git clone https://github.com/casvisor/casvisor cd casvisor/web && yarn install && yarn build && cd .. go run main.go ``` Settings are read from [conf/app.conf](conf/app.conf). Put the settings of your own server in `conf/app.local.conf` (same format, not tracked by git), or pass any of them as environment variables. ### Database The default is SQLite: ```ini driverName = sqlite dataSourceName = db/casvisor.db ``` To use MySQL instead (the database is created if it does not exist): ```ini driverName = mysql dataSourceName = root:123456@tcp(localhost:3306)/ dbName = casvisor ``` ### Sign in with Casdoor Instead of its own accounts, Casvisor can sign users in with [Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai), for SSO, MFA, LDAP and third-party logins, and use Casdoor's groups in permissions. Create an organization and an application for Casvisor in Casdoor, add `http:///callback` to the redirect URLs of the application, and set: ```ini casdoorEndpoint = https:// clientId = clientSecret = casdoorOrganization = casdoorApplication = ``` When `casdoorEndpoint` is empty, Casvisor uses its own accounts. ### Recordings Sessions are recorded to `recordings/` under the working directory (`/recordings` in Docker). `recordingPath` moves them, `recordingRetentionDays` deletes the ones older than that many days, and `disableRecording = true` turns recording off. ## Network gateways Assets in another data center, or behind NAT in an office, are reached through a network gateway. Add one under **Network gateways** and pick it in the asset's **Network gateway** field. Every connection to the asset (web SSH, Telnet, VNC, RDP, the SSH gateway and patch management) then goes through it. - **SSH jump host**: a server in that network that Casvisor can log in to over SSH. Nothing is installed on it; its sshd needs `AllowTcpForwarding yes`. - **Agent**: for networks Casvisor cannot connect into at all. Generate a token on the gateway's page and run the agent on any machine in that network: ```shell casvisor agent --server https://casvisor.example.com --token cva_... --fingerprint SHA256:... ``` The agent is the same `casvisor` binary (with Docker: `docker run -d --restart unless-stopped casbin/casvisor agent --server ...`). It connects out to Casvisor's web address over WebSocket, so it works wherever HTTPS gets out, listens on no port, and only connects to the **Allowed networks** set on the gateway. The command shown when generating the token has every flag filled in. See the [documentation](https://casvisor.org) for the token options, host key pinning and how the agent reports its status. ## Architecture | Part | Description | Stack | Source | |----------|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|------------------------| | Frontend | Web console, workbench and session player | TypeScript, React, Vite, shadcn/ui | [web](web) | | Backend | RESTful API, protocol tunnels, SSH gateway | Go, Beego, xorm, SQLite / MySQL | [casvisor](.) | | RDP | Pure-Go RDP client | Go | [casvisor/gordp](https://github.com/casvisor/gordp) | ## Contribute Questions and ideas are welcome in [issues](https://github.com/casvisor/casvisor/issues). Pull requests are welcome too, though we recommend opening an issue first to discuss larger changes. ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE)
